note: Adapted from Fauna Sinica, Insecta, Isoptera; the original is in Chinese, the original description being Han 1984 (Contr. Shanghai Inst. Entomol. 4: 198—200). The soldier measurement table gives single values only, without ranges, and they are recorded as such; the figures in parentheses for the worker are means. The original does not describe the alate.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown with reddish brown bases, antennae pale brown, anterior margin of the pronotum pale brown. Head nearly rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the frons sloping forward and slightly concave in the middle. Eyes oval, ocelli absent. Antennae 14—15-segmented, segment 1 stout and long, segment 3 equal in length to segment 2 or slightly longer, segment 4 the shortest, the terminal segment oval. Postclypeus rectangular, its anterior margin with long hairs; anteclypeus nearly trapezoidal; labrum nearly quadrate, its anterior margin rather broadly rounded, the anterior margin and the dorsal surface with long hairs. Mandibles stout, slightly swollen at the base, the outer edge nearly straight, the tip slightly curved inward. Left mandible length / head length (to mandible base) index 0.53; left mandible with 5 marginal teeth, teeth 1 and 2 nearly triangular and almost equal in length, teeth 3 and 4 short and blunt with a deep notch between them, tooth 5 slightly convex and nearly triangular; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the surface between tooth 1 and the apical tooth slightly uneven, their distance slightly more than 1.5 times the distance between tooth 1 and the apical tooth of the left mandible, tooth 1 nearly triangular, tooth 2 blunter. Postmentum slender and long, wider at the front, its lateral margins slightly concave in the middle, divided into an anterior and a posterior lobe, the middle part slender and long, the posterior end slightly swollen, the anterior margin nearly circular, the posterior margin nearly straight; postmentum width / postmentum length index 0.24, narrow postmentum width / postmentum length index 0.08, narrow postmentum width / postmentum width index 0.33. Pronotum nearly rectangular, almost as wide as the head (pronotum width / head width index 1.00), sparsely hairy, the anterior margin broadly concave with what appears to be a median notch, the anterolateral corners narrowly rounded, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight. Legs slender and long, the apex of the tibia with 3 spurs, tibial spur formula 3:3:3. Measurements: body length 11.50 mm, head length (to mandible base) 3.82 mm, head width 2.30 mm, head height 1.85 mm, head width / head length index 0.60, eye long diameter 0.25 mm, eye—antenna distance 0.20 mm, labrum length 0.45 mm, labrum width 0.60 mm, left mandible length 2.05 mm, left mandible length / head width index 0.89, postmentum length 3.09 mm, postmentum maximum width 0.75 mm, postmentum minimum width 0.25 mm, pronotum median length 1.05 mm, pronotum width 2.30 mm, hind femur length 1.50 mm, hind femur width 0.55 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head, pronotum and legs pale yellow, the abdomen darker. Head nearly circular, the eye traces indistinct. Antennae 12—16-segmented, segment 1 stout and long, segments 2 and 3 almost equal in length, segments 4—6 the shortest. Postclypeus rectangular with long hairs on the anterior margin, anteclypeus trapezoidal. Labrum nearly quadrate, with long hairs on the anterior margin and the dorsal surface. Left mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly longer than the marginal teeth, tooth 2 slightly shorter than tooth 1; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth longer than the marginal teeth, teeth 1 and 2 almost equal in length. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, the anterior margin broadly concave, the posterior margin rather straight or slightly convex. Legs slender and long, the apex of the tibia with 3 spurs. Measurements: head length (to mandible base) 1.30—1.77 (1.53) mm, head width 1.40—1.90 (1.64) mm, pronotum median length 0.55—0.95 (0.73) mm, pronotum width 1.45—2.05 (1.73) mm. Distribution Yunnan (Mangshi).
